## Names

<a id="menu_screen_script"></a>
### [`menu_screen_script`](../../../../src/menu/menu_screen_script.asm#L6) `$3DCC-$41E2`

*data*

Script that draws the menu screen (run_script, from $1d98). It sets $d020-$d023 to $0f, $01, $00, $04 and calls the script at $235e. It fills the colour RAM with 6, writes the frame characters and the tool names (Draw, Frame, Circle, Xcolor, Mirror, Line, Box, Disc, Copy, Swap, Lines, Rays, Fill, Zoom, Storage, Oops, Erase, Brushes, Color, Palette) to the screen at $5c00, and sets the colour RAM of the icons and of the colour cells. The texts are screen codes of the charset at $5000: $41-$5a capital letters, $01-$1a small letters.

<a id="menu_fill_3_rows"></a>
### [`menu_fill_3_rows`](../../../../src/menu/menu_screen_script.asm#L139) `$41E3-$41E9`

*data*

Script: writes script_fill_byte to 3 rows (3 * 40 bytes) at script_dest_ptr. menu_screen_script calls it with op 8.

<a id="menu_grid_colours"></a>
### [`menu_grid_colours`](../../../../src/menu/menu_screen_script.asm#L142) `$41EA-$4201`

*data*

Script: writes colour 0 to the colour RAM in rows 1, 5, 9 and 13: columns 1-6, 8-14, 16-22, 24-30 and 32-38. menu_screen_script calls it with op 8.
